title: רב איקא בר אבין

paragraphs: Rav Ika bar Avin said, “Rav attended to Rav Chananel.” But Nedarim reads, “Rav attended to Rabbah in the small chamber of Rav’s school,”77, end of a. Apparently an error: Rabbah did not see Rav, being much later (see there). We find Rav Chananel was Rav’s student. Megillah 3a: Rabbi Ika bar Avin said (Nedarim 37b, the same subject, has bar Abaye—an error) in Rabbi Chananel’s name in Rav’s name. Kiddushin 72a: Rabbi Ika bar Avin said in Rabbi Chananel’s name in Rav’s name. Abaye said, “Do not listen to him”; he replied, “It is not mine; it is Rabbi Chananel’s.” Abaye asked Rav Chananel. Apparently this is the early Abaye.
